column1: # Each character's stroke order as the mainland writes it (《现代汉语通用字笔顺规范》, 《通用规范汉字表》),
# a line a character: `字  笔顺编号  note`, tab-separated. 笔顺编号 is the standard's own code, a digit a
# stroke: 1 横 (提 too), 2 竖 (竖钩 too), 3 撇, 4 点 (捺 too), 5 折 (every turning stroke). The note says why
# the character's strokes are not as many as Unihan's kTotalStrokes counts, or why rime-stroke has none
# of its orders like this one; the build fails on a character either is so of without one
# (ime-dict-tool charinfo). Kept by hand from here on: a wrong order is corrected in place (git keeps
# what it was). The card shows it (CharCard).
# commit b8397db3e08e88ebbf8acf92b5cbab1a7e4c1550, 6,939 simplified characters, 26 shapes grouped into the
# five above), where it came from it does not say; corrected since by this project against the standard.
